ratings_why.fun: Every tier adds a new Guise source and the keep-or-swap choice carries the mid game, but a weak lobby leaves small bodies with little to borrow.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because Exchange makes the shop a two-way trading partner and a Guise carries its tribe, so Changelings play as half of another tribe; no tribe today does either.

verdict_why: The v3 rules gaps are closed and nothing left is broken; more passes would change the flavour of the loops, not fix them.

points.text: Bettie's payout grows with a game-long Exchange count, so late gold carried over turns into cheap Midnight Swaps and growth that speeds up each turn. That is a fine capstone chase; the owner may want to watch the turn-14 numbers.
The early game leans on the shop rolling good When played text for Cradle Kit. A plain fallback, such as +1/+1 when no shop unit has text, would keep turn-2 fights from depending on the roll.
Long-Stay Hollin pays by copied tier, which makes the Kit a good late buy. Saying on the card that a Guise's tier is the copied unit's printed tier would help players plan it.

Keeper of the Lost Hour with Turncoat Hare and Penny Second gives a strong fight high roll that reads the next board. A short line in the builds on how the Keeper treats the Fetch's Stock would make that late shape easier to aim for.

standouts.why: Penny Second steals and silences the key enemy unit, and the visible next board makes her slot a real decision.
Placement Officer now moves a Guise onto what you take, so the Exchange and Guise lines feed each other each turn.
The Matron rewards the cross-tribe board directly and grows with how far you bridge.

weakest.why: Pip Unlike is a one-off copy whose mirror only matters for a few directional texts.
Counter Stand-In needs a sell each time and does little on its own without Grandfer Acorn.
Stocks at 1/3 clog the board in fights if the Exchange line stalls.

flags.note: Exchange count only rises, so Bettie's per-turn gain keeps climbing; with Clerk replays and Midnight Swap it can run hot late.
The Lady adds an extra copy of each worn End of Turn buffer, such as Long-Stay Hollin, so board growth roughly doubles once she lands.
